question: One-third of the goods are sold at 15% profit, 25% of the goods are sold at 20% profit, and the rest of the goods are sold at 10% loss. If a profit of ₹350 is earned in the entire transaction, then the original value of the goods (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total value of goods be 1200 units (LCM of 3 and 4).

Profit on 1/3rd (400 units) at 15% = +60 units; Profit on 1/4th (300 units) at 20% = +60 units.

Loss on remaining goods (500 units) at 10% = −50 units.

Net profit = 60 + 60 − 50 = 70 units = ₹350 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹5.

Total original value = 1200 units × 5 = ₹6000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fraction of goods at 15% profit = 1/3

Fraction of goods at 20% profit = 25% = 1/4

Remaining goods = 1 − (1/3 + 1/4) = 1 − 7/12 = 5/12 (sold at 10% loss)

Total profit earned = ₹350
